Title: Azure Stack integrated systems with 16 node scale units

Body.Content:
Azure Stack is now available to scale up to 16 nodes. This means more capacity to run your most demanding workloads with the benefits of the cloud, all in your own datacenter. Whether you need 4 nodes or 16 nodes, together with our hardware partners look to deliver the scalability you need.

Learn more about Azure Stack integrated systems.

Get more information about key features and concepts in Azure Stack.
